module: Flowgraph node 'Once' (logic category, behaviour once). Lets the flow through only once (output impulse); the impulse pin 'reset' rearms it. The state is reset when execution stops.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: If reset: rearms and output false. Otherwise, if ready and input flow: output true once then ready=false; in all other cases output false.
